result:
Phase 1 is planned: two plans in two waves. The plan check passed with no CAUTION items, and nothing blocked the pipeline.

**Plans by wave**
- **Wave 1, 01-01: Rules engine, baseline AI and node tests** (engineering-senior-developer, score 13). Builds the DOM-free `Game` class in `js/engine.js` and a baseline `chooseMove` in `js/ai.js`, which Phase 3 will replace while keeping the signature. Adds a no-dependency `package.json` with `type: module`, plus `tests/engine.test.js` and `tests/ai.test.js` with one named test per rule (including head-on, same-cell, draws, round reset, match end, custom sizes and obstacles).
- **Wave 2, 01-02: Minimal page, `window.tron` hook and Playwright test** (testing-workflow-optimizer, score 8), depends on 01-01. Builds `index.html` with `#game`, `#score` and `#message`, and `js/main.js` with the hook and a basic render. `tests/hook.test.js` starts its own node static server and checks the hook in Chromium: shape of `state()`, `ai:false`, custom arenas, round flow, and no outside network requests.

**Pipeline summary (`--auto`)**

| Stage | Status | Key findings |
|---|---|---|
| Board quick-assess | Ran (3.6/10) | Its red flags only said nothing is built yet, which is expected before planning. I took two of its suggestions into the plans: edge-case tests, and `state()`/`view()` returning copies. |
| Spec / proposals | Skipped | Nothing required a spec; gates off and no spec recommendation, so no architecture proposals. |
| Decomposition | 2 plans, 2 waves | Covers REQ-03, 04, 05, 06, 11 and 12. |
| Plan critique | PASS | Mechanical check found no issues. My own review found no gaps: every requirement is covered, the tasks leave nothing to decide later, and the verify commands test the success criteria. |
| Design review | Not run | This is not a design phase. |
| Security scan | No triggers | 0 secrets and 0 dependency findings. I skipped the full OWASP review because the files don't exist yet and there is no auth or API surface. The one input-handling item, path traversal in the test server, is already in plan 01-02. |

Defaults taken because gates are off: I accepted the recommended personas, skipped architecture proposals, and did not track the phase on GitHub, so no issue was created.

The plans are in `.planning/phases/01-engine-and-test-hook/`. Next: `/triad:build 1`.
